warnings: No printed dimensions appear in the images. The overall bounds come from the supplied, unverified metadata (27 x 13.2 x 14.2 mm). The hole diameter and positions are estimated from pixel proportions in the front view, scaled to the 27 mm length, so treat them as approximate. The x axis runs along the length, y along the width, and z along the front-to-back depth. The two holes are on diagonally opposite corner tabs. Tab thickness and the exact z-offset of the tab faces are not determinable from the images. The PCB extends slightly beyond the housing in -y, and the connector sits at the rear.
Dimensions come from unverified metadata and pixel estimates.
Tab thickness, tab z-offset and tab height are guesses.
The housing's stepped profile is simplified to a single box.
The rear PCB and JST connector are omitted because their size is uncertain and they would exceed the stated Z bounds.
The window pockets are approximate in position, size and depth, and the lenses are not modeled.
Hole positions were shifted from the analysis coordinates (assumed centered in Y) to the bottom-at-Y=0 convention.
